pt_BR: Elo de ligação do Comitê, linha segura

en: Director, the Committee has two addresses for you.
pt_BR: [EN] Director, the Committee has two addresses for you.

en: Both worlds show signs of people. Filing them in your Address Book now.
pt_BR: [EN] Both worlds show signs of people. Filing them in your Address Book now.

en: We want a survey of HEARTH within ten days.
pt_BR: [EN] We want a survey of HEARTH within ten days.

en: Good work on HEARTH, Director. The Committee noticed.
pt_BR: [EN] Good work on HEARTH, Director. The Committee noticed.

en: Travellers through the ring. We are the Kindred. Why do you come?
pt_BR: [EN] Travellers through the ring. We are the Kindred. Why do you come?

en: We come in peace and want to learn.
pt_BR: [EN] We come in peace and want to learn.

en: You return. We have tasks for friends.
pt_BR: [EN] You return. We have tasks for friends.

en: Friends, we open the ring to you with a gift. Choose.
pt_BR: [EN] Friends, we open the ring to you with a gift. Choose.

en: This ring is watched by the Ossar.
pt_BR: [EN] This ring is watched by the Ossar.

en: Close it and do not return.
pt_BR: [EN] Close it and do not return.

en: Keep it shut for five days or we will answer.
pt_BR: [EN] Keep it shut for five days or we will answer.
